method: Linearly interpolated per-run quantiles, then medians across runs; no pooled-frame inference. A/A uses all original-A/B runs and one scene-wide max(5% of original median p50, four maximum observed original clock increments) tolerance for both across-run and original block checks. Separate per-route block diagnostics use max(5% of own run p50, four own clock increments). Each block is contiguous 120 frames; partial smoke blocks are labeled.
